description: Opaque burgundy knee-to-calf-length tailored noble tunic with broad gold floral woven borders down the front, at the high split neckline, around the wide cuffs and hem. Cream linen underlayer shows at the neck and long wrist cuffs. A matching burgundy mantle hangs from the shoulders, fastened by two round ornate gold brooches joined with a short chain. A brown leather waist belt has a small buckle, metal ornaments and a long hanging decorated strap. Dark fitted trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the outfit. No crown, helmet, other headgear, armor or weapon is visible.
